The following events took place in '''4050 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*[[Drokko Kira]] is banished from [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] for challenging the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] legacy of [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Freedon Nadd]]. {{Circa}}<ref name="TOTJ 2">[[Tales of the Jedi 2|''Tales of the Jedi'' 2]]</ref>
*The [[Battle of Lorell]]: the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] wipe out the [[Lorell Raiders]], forcing them to retreat to the [[Hapes Cluster/Legends|Hapes Cluster]]. The Raiders and their prisoners, most which are remarkably beautiful females, eventually develop into the isolationist and female-dominated [[Hapes Consortium/Legends|Hapes Consortium]]. {{Circa}}<ref name="Galaxy at War">''[[Galaxy at War]]''</ref>
*Scouts from the planet [[Shor]] discover the planet [[Giaca]]. {{Circa}}<ref name="Unknown Regions">''[[The Unknown Regions]]''</ref>
